name: Dahi Paneer
steps: Whisk room-temperature yogurt with chickpea flour, turmeric and 120 ml water until smooth with no flour lumps. This stabilizes the sauce when heated.
Heat oil in a heavy pan and sizzle cumin. Add onion and fry 6–7 minutes until golden, then stir in ginger and slit chilies for 1 minute.
Lower heat and stir in coriander powder. Pour in the yogurt mixture slowly while stirring without stopping. Keep the heat low until it begins to steam, not boil rapidly.
Add remaining water and salt. Simmer gently, stirring often, for 6–8 minutes until the flour is cooked and the sauce coats a spoon.
Add paneer and warm through for 3–4 minutes. Scatter coriander leaves over the pale yellow dahi gravy and serve immediately with roti.
tips: Do not use cold yogurt or boil the gravy hard; either can split the sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
